tasks.analysis: Archaeologists typically study human history and prehistory through the excavation of artifacts buried underground. Sometimes, however, they discover artifacts submerged underwater. A stone wall was found beneath the Baltic Sea in 2012 that dates to over 10,000 years ago. Researchers believe it was used by hunter-gatherer societies to guide and trap reindeer.
